import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPTS = ROOT / "scripts"
if str(SCRIPTS) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))

import omega_voice_world_patch as patch


class _Voice:
    def __init__(self):
        self.voice_full = SimpleNamespace(selected_person="gabriel", session_id="voice-session")
        self.raum_session_id = "room-session"
        self._voice_emergent_context = ""
        self._voice_emergent_queried = False
        self._voice_emergent_chars = 0
        self._voice_grid_turn_error = ""


def _full(auto_calls, retrieval_calls):
    stern = SimpleNamespace()
    def retrieval(session_id, text):
        retrieval_calls.append((session_id, text)); return "memory-context"
    def auto(session_id, text, memory):
        auto_calls.append((session_id, text, memory))
    stern.automatischer_abruf = retrieval
    stern._f2wp1207_turn_loop_auto = auto
    return SimpleNamespace(
        stern=stern,
        _refresh_emergent_grid_context=lambda self, text: None,
        _local_person_matches=lambda label: label == "gabriel",
        _current_receipt=lambda: {"owner": "gabriel", "machine_id": "ai-core-node"},
        _emergent_cache_put=lambda session_id, text, context: None,
    )


def _install_fresh(monkeypatch, full):
    monkeypatch.setattr(patch, "_PATCHED", False)
    patch.install(full)
    return full._refresh_emergent_grid_context


def test_atomic_success_never_calls_legacy_auto(monkeypatch):
    auto_calls, retrieval_calls, atomic_calls = [], [], []
    full = _full(auto_calls, retrieval_calls)
    monkeypatch.setattr(patch, "_run_atomic_voice_world_turn", lambda *a, **kw: atomic_calls.append(kw) or object())
    wrapped = _install_fresh(monkeypatch, full); voice = _Voice(); wrapped(voice, "hello")
    assert retrieval_calls == [("room-session", "hello")]
    assert len(atomic_calls) == 1
    assert auto_calls == []
    assert voice._voice_grid_turn_error == ""


def test_preflight_failure_may_fallback_exactly_once(monkeypatch):
    auto_calls, retrieval_calls = [], []
    full = _full(auto_calls, retrieval_calls)
    def atomic(*a, **kw): raise patch.VoiceWorldPreflightError("identity preflight missing")
    monkeypatch.setattr(patch, "_run_atomic_voice_world_turn", atomic)
    wrapped = _install_fresh(monkeypatch, full); voice = _Voice(); wrapped(voice, "hello")
    assert retrieval_calls == [("room-session", "hello")]
    assert auto_calls == [("room-session", "hello", "memory-context")]
    assert voice._voice_grid_turn_error == ""


def test_post_entry_error_never_falls_back_to_second_turn(monkeypatch):
    auto_calls, retrieval_calls = [], []
    full = _full(auto_calls, retrieval_calls)
    def atomic(*a, **kw): raise RuntimeError("post-entry failure")
    monkeypatch.setattr(patch, "_run_atomic_voice_world_turn", atomic)
    wrapped = _install_fresh(monkeypatch, full); voice = _Voice(); wrapped(voice, "hello")
    assert retrieval_calls == [("room-session", "hello")]
    assert auto_calls == []
    assert "post-entry failure" in voice._voice_grid_turn_error


def test_install_is_idempotent(monkeypatch):
    full = _full([], [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(patch, "_PATCHED", False)
    patch.install(full); first = full._refresh_emergent_grid_context; patch.install(full)
    assert full._refresh_emergent_grid_context is first
